name: POI Communication Type 2 Code
definition: Low level communication of the hardware or software component toward another component or an external entity.

BLTH.name: Bluetooth
BLTH.definition: Communication with a host using Bluetooth.

GPRS.name: GPRS
GPRS.definition: Communication with a host using GPRS.

GSMF.name: GSM
GSMF.definition: Communication with a host using GSM.

PSTN.name: PSTN
PSTN.definition: Communication with a host using Public Switching Telephone Network.

USBD.name: USB Device
USBD.definition: Communication with a USB stick or any USB device.

USBH.name: USB Host
USBH.definition: Communication with a host from an USB port.

WT2G.name: Wireless Technology 2 G
WT2G.definition: Includes all communication technologies which can be qualified as being part of the 2G technology (e.g EDGE or PDC).

WT3G.name: Wireless Technology 3 G
WT3G.definition: Includes all communication technologies which can be qualified as being part of the 3G technology.

WT4G.name: Wireless Technology 4 G
WT4G.definition: Includes all communication technologies which can be qualified as being part of the 4G technology.

WT5G.name: Wireless Technology 5 G
WT5G.definition: Includes all communication technologies which can be qualified as being part of the 5G technology.
